trace.question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
trace.evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);

attempts.sql:
SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The driver with the best lap time in race 19's second qualifying period was Räikkönen.
